title: senna holosericea
intro: Senna holosericea, commonly known as American senna, is a perennial shrub in the Fabaceae family, native to North America. The health benefits of American senna include its use as a natural laxative and in the treatment of digestive issues such as constipation. The therapeutic actions of American senna include stimulating bowel movements and reducing inflammation in the digestive tract. The bioactive constituents of American senna include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which contribute to its laxative properties.
